From 8f884758966259fa8c50c137ac6d4ce9bb7859db Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2021 16:22:54 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] iio: adc: at91-sama5d2: Fix buffer alignment in
 iio_push_to_buffers_with_timestamp()
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

To make code more readable, use a structure to express the channel
layout and ensure the timestamp is 8 byte aligned.

Found during an audit of all calls of this function.

Fixes: 5e1a1da0f8c9 ("iio: adc: at91-sama5d2_adc: add hw trigger and buffer support")
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>
Cc: Eugen Hristev <eugen.hristev@microchip.com>
Reviewed-by: Nuno Sá <nuno.sa@analog.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210613152301.571002-2-jic23@kernel.org

diff --git a/drivers/iio/adc/at91-sama5d2_adc.c b/drivers/iio/adc/at91-sama5d2_adc.c
index 6e8c28675947..ea5ca163d879 100644
--- a/drivers/iio/adc/at91-sama5d2_adc.c
+++ b/drivers/iio/adc/at91-sama5d2_adc.c
@@ -403,7 +403,8 @@ struct at91_adc_state {
 	struct at91_adc_dma		dma_st;
 	struct at91_adc_touch		touch_st;
 	struct iio_dev			*indio_dev;
-	u16				buffer[AT91_BUFFER_MAX_HWORDS];
+	/* Ensure naturally aligned timestamp */
+	u16				buffer[AT91_BUFFER_MAX_HWORDS] __aligned(8);
 	/*
 	 * lock to prevent concurrent 'single conversion' requests through
 	 * sysfs.
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/iio/adc/at91-sama5d2_adc.c`**
   - The `buffer` array in the `struct at91_adc_state` has been modified to ensure that it is 8-byte aligned. This is achieved by adding the `__aligned(8)` attribute to the declaration of the `buffer` array.
   - The comment above the `buffer` declaration has been updated to clarify that the alignment is specifically for ensuring a naturally aligned timestamp.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in the `at91-sama5d2_adc.c` file addresses a bug related to buffer alignment, which was identified during an audit of the function `iio_push_to_buffers_with_timestamp()`. By ensuring that the buffer is 8-byte aligned, the patch improves the readability of the code and prevents potential issues related to misalignment when handling timestamps. This change is directly linked to the previous commit that added hardware trigger and buffer support, as it aims to fix an alignment issue that could arise from those enhancements.
